criteria.text: A preview shows exact original-to-authored file mappings, complete selected tests, source and reference meaning, owned records and unresolved items, and writes nothing.
Apply consumes the shared workflow evidence association owner, keeps original receipt bytes and request or session provenance, and does not turn historical PR 1 proof into current code-head proof.
Pending, conflicting, applied and interrupted saved cases keep their full payload and exact original destination mapping, with applied-once recovery or a clear unresolved result.
Known running, paused, pending, ended and unknown simulator or job state keeps its original identity and recovery command; migration never dispatches, recreates, reopens or replays a job.
Repeated or interrupted apply preserves original state and receipts, resumes without duplication or reports conflict, and retains the old projection while unresolved items remain.

native_effects: real repository mappings and reference resolution
2899 association API integration remains separately owned
no Runtime calls; exact original read commands retained
